status: complete three-light-flavor to proton-neutron linear map at zero momentum transfer using one lattice input set

source.title: Nucleon axial, tensor and scalar charges and sigma-terms in lattice QCD
source.qualification: central values of the final renormalized physical-point single-flavor axial charges; isospin symmetry used for the neutron

map.nullDirectionMeaning: adding lambda*(1,1,9.5633187773) to (c_u,c_d,c_s) leaves both c_p and c_n unchanged

experimentalInterface.logicalLimit: electron-neutron and electron-proton products can at most recover two nucleon projections; they cannot determine all three light-quark coefficients without a third independent hadronic observable or a flavor prior

decision: The u,d,s to p,n matching is algebraically complete at this input point. Its one-dimensional kernel is structural, not a numerical deficiency. Universal light flavor is one benchmark slice, while unique quark-flavor reconstruction remains impossible from proton and neutron dipole channels alone.
